derivation: middle voice from G5228 (ὑπέρ) and G142 (αἴρω);
def: to raise oneself over, i.e. (figuratively) to become haughty
kjv: exalt self, be exalted above measure

words.word: i should be exalted above measure

occurrences.text: And lest I should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, the messenger of Satan to buffet me, lest I should be exalted above measure.
words: I should be exalted above measure
I should be exalted above measure

occurrences.text: Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God.
